verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules or event-triggered automation from the Department of State. The filing-acknowledgement email is a fixed, one-off system notification, and the announcements signup is a general newsletter; neither lets a user set rules that trigger actions on events. Probes found no API, OpenAPI spec or agent-accessible filing host that could support such automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
